Here’s a quick **smoke test** for the **Linux** Nothingness app using the existing VM-service driver `drive.py`, covering:

- **play / pause**
- **skip (next)**
- **fast forward (seek forward)**

### 0) Make sure the Linux app is running (debug mode)
From the repo, run:

```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py preflight
```

If it says “needs-launch”, copy/run the “next:” command it prints (that starts `flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart` with the right isolated HOME/log setup).

### 1) Define a track path (desktop-accessible)
This repo contains an MP3 here:

```bash
TRACK=/workspace/soloud/src/filters/signalsmith-stretch/web/demo/loop.mp3
```

(There’s only one audio file in the repo, so the queue will contain the same path twice to make `next` observable.)

### 2) Set queue + start
```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py \
  call ext.nothingness.setQueue \
  paths=$TRACK,$TRACK startIndex=0
```

(Optional) Check state:
```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect
```

### 3) Play / pause
```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py pause
sleep 2
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py resume
sleep 2
```

(Optional) Verify:
```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect
```

### 4) Skip (next)
```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py next
sleep 2
```

### 5) Fast forward (seek forward)
Seek to 30 seconds:

```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py seek 0:30
sleep 2
```

(Optional) Verify:
```bash
python3 .agents/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py inspect
```

If you tell me what `drive.py inspect` shows for `isPlaying` / current track / position after each step, I can help confirm it’s behaving correctly (or adjust the seek amount if the track is shorter).
